persuasion.residual_concern: Left bar charts in both delivered page sets cannot be pixel-verified at this rendering; rounds 3-4 showed off-scale left figures. Prose governs; my own figure should use a stated fixed scale.
persuasion.strongest_counterargument: P4 sits exactly at the five-defect ceiling with zero spare slots, and the 9 kWh P2-P3 margin is the smallest gap, so the selection is least robust to a measurement revision.
